content.title: View a published book's details
content.description: A reader opens an individual published book page to inspect enough bibliographic detail to trust the listing—including title, author, genre, rating, format, ISBN, publication month, blurb, and cover image—while also seeing which publishing package produced the book and receiving a call to action back into the publishing flow; nonexistent books return 404s.
content.summary: View a published book’s detail page.
content.value: Makes each showcased title credible and converts readers back into prospective authors.
criteria: The page shows the title, `by <author>`, the genre, `Rating: <n>`, the format, a valid `ISBN: <isbn-13>`, `Published <Month YYYY>`, and the blurb.
The page shows a cover image for the book.
The page states `Published via our <package name> package.` and links that package name to the package page.
A `Publish your book like this one` call to action leads to `/publish`.
Requesting a book that does not exist returns a 404.
